3000L: Cortech X-Tray Insulated Food Tray Lid
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-3000l-x-tray-food-tray-lid
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/food-service/correctional-food-trays/x-tray/
Spec sheet: X-Tray and lids
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech X-Tray Insulated Food Tray Lid – 3000L
Current H1: Cortech Lid for X-Tray Insulated Food Tray - 3000L
Subtitle: Lid for the Cortech X-Tray That Seals Every Compartment, in Four Colors
Current subtitle: Cortech USA 3000CL, 3000DGL, 3000TCL, 3000OL
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech X-Tray Insulated Food Tray Lid covers the Cortech X-Tray (sold separately) for meal delivery in prisons, jails, and other correctional facilities. With the lid on, the X-Tray’s tongue and groove design seals the entire perimeter and every compartment.
The lids come in the same four colors as the X-Tray, and lidded trays stack in the Chuckwagon and Chuckwagon Jr. delivery carts.
Fit: Made for the Cortech X-Tray (3000)
Seal: Tongue and groove design seals the entire perimeter and all individual compartments
Depth: With the lid on, the X-Tray’s feeding surface is 2” deep
Cart Capacity: 72 X-Trays with lids in the Chuckwagon or 40 in the Chuckwagon Jr.
Colors: Brown, Dark Gray, Terracotta, or Orange (custom colors available on request)
Packaging: Sold in cases of 10
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
3000CL – Brown: X-Tray lid
3000DGL – Dark Gray: X-Tray lid
3000TCL – Terracotta: X-Tray lid
3000OL – Orange: X-Tray lid
Installation and Options
No assembly is required.
[H2] Applications
The X-Tray lid suits facilities that deliver meals on X-Trays and need covered, stackable trays.
Typical applications include:
Inmate meal service in prisons, jails, and detention centers
Central kitchens that deliver meals to housing units
Juvenile detention and other secure facilities
Explore Anchortex's Prison and Detention Kitchen and Food Service Equipment collection for more food trays, delivery carts, and food service supplies.
[H2] About Cortech Food Service
Cortech food service products are made for high-volume meal service in correctional facilities, where trays, carts, and dispensers are used and washed every day. Cortech trays and delivery carts are sized to work together.
Cortech food service includes:
Insulated Food Trays: The Rock, Rock 2.0, Rock with Cor-Flex, and X-Tray, with matching lids
Tray Delivery Carts: The insulated Chuckwagon, Chuckwagon Jr., and Chuckwagon Max, and the non-insulated Tray Master
Beverage Service: The BevMax insulated beverage dispenser
Tray Drying: Aluminum meal tray drying racks
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (59 characters): Cortech X-Tray Insulated Food Tray Lid - 3000L at Anchortex
Meta description (148 characters): Shop the Cortech X-Tray Lid. A lid for the Cortech X-Tray that seals the entire perimeter and every compartment, sold in cases of 10 in four colors.
Notes and Questions
Series section: "About Cortech Food Service" is a new section for the food service pages (trays, lids, delivery carts, BevMax, and drying racks). It is the same on each of these pages.
H1: I put "X-Tray" first and moved "Lid" to the end, to match the other lid pages.
Model numbers: the Cortech spec sheet lists the lids as 3000CL, 300DGL, 3000TCL, and 30000L. The "300DGL" and "30000L" look like typos for 3000DGL and 3000OL, so I used your model numbers.
Weight and size: the Cortech spec sheet does not give a weight or size for the lids, so I left them out.
Warranty: the Cortech spec sheet gives a 5-year warranty for the X-Tray but does not say whether it covers the lids, so I left the warranty out.
Price: your current page says "Packed 10 per case, must buy in full cases. Price is per case." I kept "Sold in cases of 10."
Variant names: your variants say "Chocolate Brown," "Dark Grey," and "Terra Cotta." The Cortech spec sheet says "Brown," "Dark Gray," and "Terracotta." Would you like them renamed, for example "3000CL - Brown"?
Collection link: I linked the Prison and Detention Kitchen and Food Service Equipment collection, which this product is already in.
Product images: the page has one image. The Cortech product page has three photos of the X-Tray lid in gray, orange, and terracotta. Would you like me to add them?
